rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the classical dance and, when context is clear, a ballet performance.

example.english: I studied ballet when I was young.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 hok6 gwo3 baa1 leoi4 mou5

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a staged ballet performance rather than the dance form itself.

example.english: We’re going to watch a ballet performance tonight.
example.traditional: 今晚我哋去睇芭蕾舞表演。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 baa1 leoi4 mou5 biu2 jin2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the organized company of people who perform ballet.

example.english: That ballet company often tours abroad.
example.traditional: 嗰個芭蕾舞團成日去外國巡演。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 baa1 leoi4 mou5 tyun4 sing4 jat6 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 ceon4 jin2
